name: trendishop
description: TrendiShop — e-commerce platform. Next.js storefront + admin (TrendiShop_Client) and Express API (TrendiShop_Server).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix TrendiShop_Server install && npm --prefix TrendiShop_Client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix TrendiShop_Server run build && npm --prefix TrendiShop_Client run build
scripts.typecheck: cd TrendiShop_Server && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../TrendiShop_Client && npx tsc --noEmit
